note: After the complete redescription of Thai specimens by Ahmad 1965 (in English); the original description is Holmgren 1914 (Mirotermes (Mirotermes) propinquus, soldier and worker only), and the redescription covering both sexes is used here. The text was extracted by OCR from an Internet Archive scan and the measurement figures were checked.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head chestnut brown, paler on the vertex; postclypeus light brown; antennae brown; pronotum one shade paler than the head. Head covered with short hairs of moderate density; labrum sparsely hairy; pronotum with numerous short hairs and scattered long setae. Head nearly circular; fontanelle slit-like. Compound eyes small, moderately projecting, almost circular, the lower margin about 1/5 of the short diameter of the eye from the lower margin of the head. Ocelli broadly oval, their distance from the compound eye half their short diameter or less. Postclypeus convex, its length almost half its width. Antennae 15 segments, segment 2 twice as long as segment 3, segment 3 the shortest, segment 4 shorter than segment 2 and almost as long as segment 5. Pronotum narrower than the head, the anterior margin weakly concave, the lateral margins evenly curved.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head yellow, the margins of the frontal projection, the antennal ridges and the anterolateral corners of the head capsule tinged with brown; mandibles dark reddish brown; antennae yellow with a brownish tinge; thorax, legs and abdomen milky white. Head hairs sparse; long hairs at the apex of the frontal projection and a few hairs on the anterior part of the labrum; pronotal hairs sparse. Head rectangular, almost 1.5 times as long as broad; frontal projection long and slender, in lateral view with a convex anterior margin, directed backwards. Anterior margin of the labrum slightly undulate, the anterolateral corners extended into tapering processes. Mandibles long and slender; left mandible distinctly curved, right mandible almost straight. Anterior part of the postmentum 1.5 times as broad as the posterior part, the narrowest point nearer the posterior margin than the widest point. Antennae 14 segments, segment 2 longer than segment 3, segments 3 and 4 nearly equal in length. Anterior and posterior margins of the pronotum not concave.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Measurements (mm, range/mean). Alate (10 individuals): head length (to the apex of the clypeus) 0.78—0.91/0.85; head length (to the lateral base of the mandibles) 0.52—0.62/0.56; head width 0.67—0.75/0.72; compound eye long diameter 0.19—0.23/0.21, short diameter 0.19—0.22/0.20; lower margin of the compound eye to the lower margin of the head 0.03—0.05/0.03; ocellus length 0.05—0.07/0.06, width 0.05—0.06/0.05; ocellus to compound eye 0.02—0.03/0.02; postclypeus length 0.18, width 0.36—0.39/0.36; pronotum length 0.33—0.41/0.35, width 0.54—0.65/0.59. Soldier (10 individuals): head length (to the apex of the frontal projection) 1.24—1.40/1.33; head length (to the lateral base of the mandibles) 0.98—1.11/1.06; head width 0.68—0.75/0.72; head height 0.66—0.72/0.68; frontal projection length 0.20—0.26/0.23; left mandible length 1.19—1.27/1.23; postmentum length 0.49—0.57/0.54; postmentum maximum width 0.26—0.28/0.27, minimum width 0.15—0.22/0.18; pronotum length 0.19—0.23/0.21, width 0.40—0.46/0.43.
